rule: Two kinds of facts live here and they are never merged. INTENDED fields (intended_asin, official_listing_url, confirmation_date, confirmation_source) are filled only when the owner or an official Associates record confirms the product. OBSERVED fields (observed_*) are what an Amazon page showed on a dated fetch, and are kept separate on purpose. A blank cell means 'not confirmed', never 'guessed'. Specs come from the manufacturer page named in 'spec_sources'; where two official pages disagree, the value is left blank and a flag explains why.

products.name: ThermoMaven F1 Ace instant-read meat thermometer
products.observed_title: ThermoMaven 1 Sec Professional Digital Meat Thermometer, ±0.5℉ Accuracy | NIST&NSF Certified, Auto-Rotate Bright LED Screen, IP67 Waterproof for Grill BBQ, Stocking Stuffers Gifts for Men, Black
products.observed_breadcrumb: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Kitchen Utensils & Gadgets > Thermometers & Timers > Meat
products.capacity_note: Not a capacity product: this is a handheld probe.
products.functions: 1-second thermocouple spot check; motion-sensing wake/sleep; auto-rotating display; built-in magnet. No leave-in oven rating is published.
products.dishwasher_safe: Not stated as dishwasher-safe. The maker says '100% waterproof design' and 'rinse under water'; that is not the same claim.
products.certification: NIST-certified +/-0.5 F accuracy (manufacturer). The listing also claims NSF certification.
products.warranty: Lifetime warranty with registration within 30 days (manufacturer); no fixed period is stated.
products.best_for: A quick spot check at the grill, not an unattended cook.
products.tradeoff: It reads one spot at a time, so it cannot watch a long smoke the way a leave-in probe can. The maker publishes no leave-in or IP rating.
products.fit_line: A quick spot check at the grill, not a leave-in monitor.
products.lede: A folding one-second thermocouple for the moment before you pull the meat off the heat. A different job from a leave-in probe, and the maker publishes no oven-stay rating.
products.guide_title: Is your meat thermometer telling you the right number?
